channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.14.0-beta (96)
item.description:
• Full screen stays on the next photo when you delete, and the other thumbnails stay on screen.
  • The open photo shows the focus box, grid lines, neighboring frames, your stars, Pick, and Reject.
  • Compare, turn a JPEG, collage, panorama, a histogram, clipped tones, and 1:1 of the preview.
  • Enter confirms Archive and Move.
